answers.description: Evaluation answers keyed by question ID: choice, score, or noul, with probabilities and confidence where applicable

data.description: API response data (JSON, text, or other formats)

headers.description: HTTP response headers as key-value pairs

conditionResult.description: Whether the selected branch's own test passed: true when an if/else-if condition matched, false when the else branch or no branch fired

selectedTitle.description: Title of the selected branch (e.g. "if", "else if", "else"); null when no branch fired

result.description: Structured result emitted by the executed code

stdout.description: Console log output and debug messages from function execution

files.description: Files the code wrote to /tmp/sim/outputs, ready to attach or upload downstream

id.description: Gmail message ID (thread ID for thread operations, label ID for label operations, draft ID for Get Draft)

bcc.description: Bcc recipients (only on messages you sent or drafted)

rfcMessageId.description: RFC Message-ID header (not the Gmail message id)

snippet.description: Short excerpt of the message text

internalDate.description: Gmail internal creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds

results.description: Search/read summary results [{id, threadId, subject, from, to, cc, bcc, replyTo, date, snippet, rfcMessageId, inReplyTo, references, internalDate}]

nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page of results

messageListVisibility.description: Message list visibility of the label

labelListVisibility.description: Label list visibility of the label

deleted.description: Whether the label or draft was deleted

messages.description: Thread messages [{id, threadId, labelIds, snippet, from, to, cc, bcc, replyTo, subject, date, rfcMessageId, inReplyTo, references, internalDate, body}]

historyId.description: ID of the last history record that modified the thread

trashed.description: Whether the thread was moved to trash

untrashed.description: Whether the thread was restored from trash

messageId.description: Gmail message ID for the draft

labels.description: Email labels (trigger, comma-separated); for List Labels, the label array [{id, name, type, messageListVisibility, labelListVisibility}]

raw_email.description: Complete raw email data from Gmail API (if enabled)

filter.description: Filter summary (present only when a filter was requested): applied, column, matchType, columnFound, matchedRows, totalRows

majorDimension.description: Major dimension of the returned values (ROWS or COLUMNS)

updatedData.description: Values of the updated cells (range, majorDimension, values), present only when Return Updated Values is on

title.description: Spreadsheet title (or copied sheet title for copy_sheet)

sheets.description: List of sheets in the spreadsheet

valueRanges.description: Array of value ranges read from the spreadsheet

responses.description: Array of update responses for each range

clearedRanges.description: Array of ranges that were cleared

sheetId.description: ID of the copied sheet in the destination, or the sheet the rows were deleted from

sheetType.description: Type of the sheet (GRID, CHART, etc.)

deletedRowRange.description: Description of the deleted row range

deletedSheetId.description: The numeric ID of the deleted sheet

deleted.description: Whether the spreadsheet was successfully deleted

metadata.description: Spreadsheet metadata including ID and URL

resumeEndpoint.description: Resume API endpoint URL for direct curl requests

response.description: Display data shown to the approver

submission.description: Form submission data from the approver

resumeInput.description: Raw input data submitted when resuming

submittedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the workflow was resumed

cost.description: Search cost breakdown: input, output, and total USD for the query embedding, plus rerankerCost, rerankerModel, and rerankerSearchUnits when a reranker ran. Absent when the search was not billed (e.g. tag-only search or BYOK).

tokens.description: Token usage of the query embedding: prompt, completion, and total. Present with cost.

model.description: Embedding model that scored the query. Present with cost.

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this route was chosen

options.label: Get Team Do Not Disturb Info

subBlocks.title: Include Files Hidden by Plan Limit

message.description: Complete message object with all properties: ts, text, user, channel, reactions, threads, files, attachments, blocks, stars, pins, and edit history

ts.description: Message timestamp returned by Slack API

channel.description: Channel identifier where message was sent

fileCount.description: Number of files uploaded (when files are attached)

messageTs.description: Timestamp of the ephemeral message (cannot be used to update or delete)

canvas.description: Canvas file metadata returned by Slack

canvases.description: Array of canvas file objects returned by Slack

sections.description: Canvas section IDs returned by Slack section lookup

status.description: List export job status, or agent session status

agentStatus.description: Agent session status recorded by Slack

parentMessage.description: The thread parent message with all properties

replies.description: Array of reply messages in the thread (excluding the parent)

replyCount.description: Number of replies returned in this response

hasMore.description: Whether more thread messages or provider pages remain beyond the fetched window

pages.description: Number of provider pages fetched during a paginated read

threadTs.description: Thread timestamp an assistant status/title/prompts op was set on

channels.description: One page of accessible public and private channel objects, including conversation type and membership fields.

count.description: Total number of items returned (channels, members, or users)

nextCursor.description: Continuation cursor; empty or null when finished

members.description: Array of user IDs who are members of the channel

ids.description: IDs of the returned channels or users

names.description: Names of the returned channels or users

users.description: User IDs or a map of user IDs to Do Not Disturb state

user.description: Detailed user object with properties: id, name, real_name, display_name, first_name, last_name, title, is_bot, is_admin, deleted, timezone, avatars, status

file.description: Downloaded file stored in execution files

metadata.description: Updated message metadata (legacy, use message object instead)

channelInfo.description: Detailed channel object with properties: id, name, is_private, is_archived, is_member, num_members, topic, purpose, created, creator

online.description: Whether user has an active client connection (only available when checking own presence)

autoAway.description: Whether user was automatically set to away (only available when checking own presence)

manualAway.description: Whether user manually set themselves as away (only available when checking own presence)

connectionCount.description: Total number of active connections (only available when checking own presence)

lastActivity.description: Unix timestamp of last detected activity (only available when checking own presence)

view.description: View object with properties: id, team_id, type, title, submit, close, blocks, private_metadata, callback_id, external_id, state, hash, clear_on_close, notify_on_close, root_view_id, previous_view_id, app_id, bot_id

errors.description: Array of per-user error objects when force is true and some invitations failed (user, ok, error)

scheduledMessageId.description: Identifier of the scheduled message (used to delete it before it posts)

postAt.description: Unix timestamp when a scheduled message will post

scheduledMessages.description: Array of pending scheduled message objects with properties: id, channel_id, post_at, date_created, text

purpose.description: The purpose/description that was set on the channel

event_type.description: Type of Slack event that triggered the workflow

subtype.description: Message subtype (e.g., channel_join, channel_leave, bot_message). Null for regular user messages

channel_type.description: Type of channel (e.g., channel, group, im, mpim)

bot_id.description: Bot ID if the message was sent by a bot. Null for human users

timestamp.description: Message timestamp from the triggering event

thread_ts.description: Parent thread timestamp (if message is in a thread)

event_id.description: Unique event identifier for the trigger

profile.description: User profile or workspace custom profile fields

emoji.description: Custom emoji names mapped to image URLs or aliases

download_url.description: List export download URL when ready

dnd_enabled.description: Whether Do Not Disturb is enabled

next_dnd_start_ts.description: Next Do Not Disturb start timestamp

next_dnd_end_ts.description: Next Do Not Disturb end timestamp

comments.description: File comments (id, comment, user, created, timestamp)

fileMetadata.description: Slack file metadata (id, name, title, mimetype, permalink)

conversation.description: Opened or joined conversation details (id, name, is_im, is_mpim)

schema.description: Created column schema (id, key, name, type, options); null when Slack omits it

list.description: List metadata (id, title, schema); null when not included

items.description: List rows, pinned items, or reacted-to items, depending on the operation

item.description: One row (id, list_id, fields, timestamps, parent_record_id)

rowCount.description: Rows returned (query) or total rows in the table (get schema)

totalCount.description: Total rows matching the predicate (first page only)

nextCursor.description: Cursor to fetch the next page, or null on the last page

columns.description: Column definitions (each includes its stable id)

maxRows.description: Max rows per table for the workspace's plan

bcc.description: BCC recipients (only present on messages you sent)

rfcMessageId.description: RFC Message-ID header (not the Gmail message ID)

inReplyTo.description: In-Reply-To header (RFC Message-ID of the parent message)

references.description: References header (RFC Message-IDs in the thread)

snippet.description: Short excerpt of the message text

attachments.description: Array of email attachments as files (if includeAttachments is enabled)

row.description: Row data mapped to column headers from row 1

rawRow.description: Raw row values as an array

rowNumber.description: The 1-based row number of the new row

event_type.description: Type of Slack payload: an Events API event (e.g., app_mention, message), an interactivity type (e.g., block_actions), or "slash_command" for slash commands

subtype.description: Message subtype (e.g., channel_join, channel_leave, bot_message, file_share). Null for regular user messages

channel.description: Slack channel ID where the event occurred

channel_type.description: Type of channel (e.g., channel, group, im, mpim). Useful for distinguishing DMs from public channels

user.description: User ID who triggered the event

bot_id.description: Bot ID if the message was sent by a bot. Null for human users

text.description: Message text content. For slash commands, the text after the command. For interactivity, the source message text (falls back to the triggering action value)

timestamp.description: Message timestamp from the triggering event

thread_ts.description: Parent thread timestamp (if message is in a thread)

streaming_message_ts.description: Message timestamps streamed during a stopped agent session

tab.description: App Home tab that was opened, including messages for Agent View

context.description: Current Agent View context. Normalized from context on app_context_changed/app_home_opened or app_context on message.im

user_team_id.description: Slack workspace/team ID of the user who triggered the event. Used for Slack Connect response streaming.

reaction.description: Emoji reaction name (e.g., thumbsup). Present for reaction_added/reaction_removed events

item_user.description: User ID of the original message author. Present for reaction_added/reaction_removed events

command.description: Slash command name including the leading slash (e.g., /deploy). Present for slash commands

action_id.description: action_id of the first interactive element triggered. Present for block_actions (button/select clicks)

action_value.description: Value carried by the first interactive element (button value, selected option, date, etc.). Present for block_actions

actions.description: Full array of interactive actions from the payload, preserving every element and its value. Present for block_actions

response_url.description: Temporary URL to post a response back to the originating message or command. Present for interactivity and slash commands

trigger_id.description: Short-lived trigger ID used to open a modal in response. Present for interactivity and slash commands

callback_id.description: Callback ID of the shortcut or view. Present for shortcuts and modal submissions

api_app_id.description: Slack app ID. Present for interactivity and slash commands

app_id.description: App ID of the app that produced the event (e.g. the bot that posted a message). Used to identify the app's own output

message_ts.description: Timestamp of the message the interaction originated from. Present for block_actions

view.description: Full Slack view object for modal interactions: state.values (submitted input values), private_metadata, id, callback_id, and hash. Present for view_submission/view_closed; null otherwise

message.description: Full source message object the interaction came from, including its blocks and text. Present for block_actions on a message; null otherwise

state.description: Current values of all stateful elements in the surface (state.values) at the time of a block action — e.g. inputs read on a button click. Present for block_actions; null otherwise

hasFiles.description: Whether the message has file attachments

files.description: File attachments downloaded from the message (if includeFiles is enabled and bot token is provided)

row.description: Row data mapped to column names (when header mapping is enabled)

previousRow.description: Previous row data before an update or deletion (null for inserts)

changedColumns.description: List of column names that changed (empty for inserts and deletes)

headers.description: Column names from the table schema
